description: Tier-2 command, relative to the repository root, run on the combined head and on every bisection prefix (its sha is appended; the members and base arrive in GATE_BATCH_MEMBERS and GATE_BATCH_BASE): scripts/gate-batch --tier 2 gates that commit with the union plan of its members (GX-30, B-20 (a)), so a batch runs only the stages its members can affect, with the caches train.tier2_test_cache names (fresh by default). Rollback: ["scripts/gate-dev", "--sha"], the full dev plan, which ignores the batch variables.
